title: AntecedentsIER: Analysis code for perceived and own negative emotions as antecedents of interpersonal emotion regulation in couples
description:
This repository contains the R code used for the analyses in the manuscript "Perceived negative emotions of the target and regulator's own negative emotions as antecedents of interpersonal emotion regulation". The study examines whether a regulator's perception of their partner's negative emotions and the regulator's own negative emotions predict engagement in interpersonal emotion regulation in romantic couples. Data come from a laboratory conflict interaction with video-mediated recall and from a 14-day experience sampling study.

The code fits lagged multilevel models for indistinguishable dyads (within-person level) and applies the Truth and Bias model (West & Kenny, 2011) to estimate person-level directional bias and projection bias, which are then used to predict mean interpersonal emotion regulation engagement (between-person level). All analyses use the nlme package in R. The data are not shared publicly because they contain sensitive personal information; they are available from the authors upon reasonable request.
